title: Not bad
text:
I received 7 items. 5 are full size and 2 are travel size. Therabox add in a "surprise scratch off activity book". I have not tried any of the products yet.
Next month I may skip to try out Fabfit box. Those are the same price(I believe) and I believe they come with more items.
I only paid $20 with a promotion Amazon was running. Not sure I would pay $40 for this every month. But it was a nice treat for myself.
label: neutral
